out.title: Sangeeta Shetty appointed Company Secretary; Ashish Agarwal resigns
out.summary: Ashish Agarwal resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 29, 2026, citing personal reasons. Sangeeta Shetty appointed Chief Compliance Officer and Company Secretary from November 2, 2026, reporting to CEO Punit Goenka.

person.name: Sangeeta Shetty
person.role: Chief Compliance Officer and Company Secretary
person.bio: Qualified Company Secretary, Associate Member of ICSI (ACS 18865), with over two decades' experience in Companies Act, SEBI LODR, board governance, capital-market transactions and listed-entity compliance.
